summary: Oculis Holding AG filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, publishing the invitation to its 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for May 13, 2026. The filing includes the press release, meeting invitation, proxy card, and 2025 Annual Report. The meeting will be held in-person with a broadcast option; no virtual participation is available. Shareholders on Nasdaq US receive physical proxy materials; those on Nasdaq Iceland vote electronically. An information session for shareholders is set for May 11, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
